subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

The black sheep

options.text: The least reputable member of a group

solution:
The correct answer is "**The least reputable member of a group**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An idiom is a group of words, or in other words, a phrase that has a meaning different from the literal meaning of the words in it. 

 
 
• Example: Beat around the bush. Meaning: To avoid saying something.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "black sheep" refers to someone who is considered the least respectable or honorable member of a group. **
 
• This person is often looked down upon or ostracized by others in the group.
 
 
• Example: Radhika is the black sheep in the family because she is an artist whereas everyone else is an economist.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4.**
